strategy: Consolidate repeated config RPC arrangements into explicit rows; use the canonical admitted-write recovery contract instead of replaying it through an installed-package fixture.

removedCases: accepts runtime-shaped config.set when bundled provider baseUrl was only defaulted
accepts config.patch when bundled provider baseUrl was only defaulted
preserves authored empty bundled provider models during config.patch
entries.keeperCase: preserves provider source ownership through $method (authored models: $authoredModels)
entries.invariant: Full runtime-shaped replacement and partial patch preserve authored model lists without writing defaulted provider base URLs.
entries.carriedUniqueAssertions: Original provider shapes, ports, empty runtime baseUrl/models for set, absent persisted baseUrl, omitted default model list for patch, retained authored empty list, and cleanup.

removedCases: allows config.patch to append array entries without replacePaths
allows config.patch to shrink an existing array with replacePaths
rows: shrink an existing array with replacePaths
entries.invariant: Append is non-destructive; shrinking an array requires explicit replacement authority.
entries.carriedUniqueAssertions: Identical seeded and replacement bindings, presence or absence of replacePaths, successful seed/patch, final array equality, and config restoration.

removedCases: rejects config.set when SecretRef resolution fails
rejects config.patch when merged SecretRefs cannot resolve
rejects config.apply when SecretRef resolution fails
entries.keeperCase: rejects $method when active SecretRefs cannot resolve without changing the source
entries.invariant: Every config write endpoint rejects unresolved active SecretRefs before committing.
entries.carriedUniqueAssertions: Full replacement versus partial patch, original missing-variable prefixes, 20000ms timeout, resolution error and unchanged hash. Apply raw-byte assertion now covers all endpoints. Prior sendConfigSet/sendConfigApply wrappers directly delegate to rpcReq.

removedCases: rejects config.patch that removes existing array entries without shrinking length
rejects nested destructive array patches when replacePaths names only a parent object
rejects deleting a nested parent object inside id-keyed arrays without replacePaths
rows: removes existing array entries without shrinking length
shrinks a nested array with only its parent in replacePaths
deletes the parent of a nested array without replacePaths
entries.invariant: Destructive array changes require exact array-path replacement authority, including ancestor deletion.
entries.carriedUniqueAssertions: Original seeded arrays, patches, parent-only replacePaths, exact error paths, rejection, unchanged hash/disk bytes, and retained bindings/entries.

removedCases: retries after an admitted call outlasts the replacement deadline without restarting its sibling
entries.keeperCase: waits for an admitted write before replacement and keeps serving on timeout (%i ms)
entries.invariant: An admitted write outlives replacement observation without disposal; the prior generation keeps serving, then retry retires it once and leaves its sibling untouched.
entries.carriedUniqueAssertions: Existing keeper verifies file write exactly once, uncommitted drain error, old registry/live signal, no disposal/start/stop during timeout, restored serving/readiness, successful retry, one disposal and unchanged sibling. Installed-package pending/candidate/recovery disposal rows retain captured-code/resource-lock coverage.

validation: Code-only self-review and git diff --check. Coordinator owns formatting, types, and runtime proof.
